en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large hilltop castle complex with a tall tower and multiple attached buildings, identified in German as Schloss Weesenstein. The castle overlooks a small river or stream running through a valley, with trees, fields, and a few houses in the foreground. A small steam train with smoke from its chimney is visible on tracks beside the river. The printed caption at the top reads "Schloss Weesenstein i. Müglitztale."
